text:
elaine (marketing): quick ask — planning launch narrative and need a focused probe on sample-selection bias + percentile stability for long-context (>4k) demo traffic. want methodology + raw artifacts for any claims.

sam (eng-runtime): ok. need exact cohort, payload examples, warmup policy, and which quantized variants. also will this run on dedicated pool or shared?

elaine (marketing): cohort = 2k samples from demo traffic (mix: news, long-form docs, code). slices: long (>4k), mid (1k-4k), short (<1k). payload example:

```json
{"prompt": "Summarize the following article in ~3 bullets:", "context": "<~4500 tokens of news article text>", "max_tokens": 256, "temperature": 0.0}
```

elaine (marketing): run two warmup modes: coldstart (no prefix cache) and representative warmup (single prefix warmup per model as in prod). annotate warmup sequences.

jia (eng-ml): metrics: p50/p90/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, cost-per-k-token estimate, token-efficiency delta, generation-quality delta (embedding similarity to fp16), failure counts, KV-cache hit rates, and top-k divergence for identical seeds.

anil (product): call out any systematic sample bias (e.g., code vs news variance). provide reproducibility checklist and minimal runbook so marketing can validate claims.

sam (eng-runtime): proposed models: ["redwood-xl-8k-fp16", "redwood-xl-8k-4bit-quant", "redwood-xl-16k-fp16(fallback)"] — confirm.

elaine (marketing): names good. need raw sample IDs + hashed payloads for chain-of-custody. retention: keep raw outputs + traces for 30 days; export sanitized CSV for marketing.

sam (eng-runtime): randomness question: do you want randomized ordering across models or fixed ordering for paired comparisons?

jia (eng-ml): do both: randomized repeats (N=5) for variance estimation, then one deterministic paired run (same order) for direct deltas. save seeds and repeat logs.

sam (eng-runtime): plan: smoke today to validate configs; full sweep = ~2k samples x 3 slices x 3 models x 6 repeats => ~36k requests + warmups. bench-bot to schedule on dedicated pool.

bench-bot: scheduled job b-1749998888 on ded-pool-7. ETA 30-40h. artifacts -> /artifacts/marketing/1749998888/ (raw_outputs, traces, metrics.csv, methodology.md).

sam (eng-runtime): we'll include methodology doc (configs, SDK calls, warmup commands), reproducibility script, and per-slice breakdown. ETA 48h to artifact availability. :+1:

elaine (marketing): perfect — marketing will hold quantitative claims until paired-run numbers land. ping early if any blockers. :pray:
